podcasts.title: Academic Agent — áudio

podcasts.description: Episódios do canal Academic Agent em formato de áudio, reunidos em um feed não oficial para escuta em aplicativos de podcast.

episodes.title: The CIA Propaganda Trick That Still Shapes What You Believe | Hugh Wilford
episodes.description: An analysis of how CIA psychological operations shaped the cultural landscape of the Cold War, including the methods used to influence public sentiment through organised propaganda.

episodes.title: What the CIA Didn't Want You to Know | Frances Stonor Saunders
episodes.description: Frances Stonor Saunders discusses the CIA, cultural influence and the hidden history behind Cold War intellectual life.

episodes.title: The Myth of Raw Talent: Why Repetition is Everything | Alex Ferguson
episodes.description: A discussion of raw ability, repetition and the habits required to turn potential into long-term success.
